agencies_overrides_non_negative.name: agencies_overrides_non_negative
agencies_overrides_non_negative.value:
coalesce("agencies"."first_request_due_days", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("agencies"."upcoming_days", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("agencies"."follow_up_days", 1) >= 1 AND coalesce("agencies"."statement_request_days", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("agencies"."statement_follow_up_days", 1) >= 1

bills_of_lading_payment_active.name: bills_of_lading_payment_active
bills_of_lading_payment_active.where: "bills_of_lading"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."deposit_payment_id" IS NOT NULL

bills_of_lading_void.name: bills_of_lading_void
bills_of_lading_void.value:
("bills_of_lading"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("bills_of_lading"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bills_of_lading"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("bills_of_lading"."void_reason")) > 0)

deposit_payments_void.name: deposit_payments_void
deposit_payments_void.value:
("deposit_payments"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "deposit_payments"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "deposit_payments"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("deposit_payments"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deposit_payments"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("deposit_payments"."void_reason")) > 0)

email_bl_links_unlinked.name: email_bl_links_unlinked
email_bl_links_unlinked.value: ("email_bl_links"."unlinked_at" IS NULL) = ("email_bl_links"."unlinked_by" IS NULL) AND ("email_bl_links"."unlinked_at" IS NULL OR "email_bl_links"."linked_by" <> 'THREAD')

ledger_entries_statement_document.name: ledger_entries_statement_document
ledger_entries_statement_document.value: "ledger_entries"."deduction_source" IS NOT 'STATEMENT' OR "ledger_entries"."document_id" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_dispute.name: ledger_entries_dispute
ledger_entries_dispute.value:
("ledger_entries"."disputed" = 0 AND "ledger_entries"."dispute_note" IS NULL)
        OR ("ledger_entries"."disputed" = 1 AND "ledger_entries"."type" = 'DEDUCTION' AND "ledger_entries"."compensates_entry_id" IS NULL AND length(trim("ledger_entries"."dispute_note")) > 0)

receipt_queue_resolution.name: receipt_queue_resolution
receipt_queue_resolution.value:
("receipt_queue"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "receipt_queue"."resolution" IS NULL AND "receipt_queue"."payment_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipt_queue"."resolution" = 'DISCARDED' AND "receipt_queue"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_queue"."payment_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("receipt_queue"."resolution" = 'SAVED' AND "receipt_queue"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_queue"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

refund_allocations_reversal.name: refund_allocations_reversal
refund_allocations_reversal.value: ("refund_allocations"."state" = 'REVERSED') = ("refund_allocations"."reversed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "refund_allocations"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("refund_allocations"."reversal_reason")) > 0)

refunds_void.name: refunds_void
refunds_void.value:
("refunds"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "refunds"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "refunds"."void_reason" IS NULL)
      OR ("refunds"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("refunds"."void_reason")) > 0)

replies_email_bl_unique.name: replies_email_bl_unique
replies_email_bl_unique.where: "replies"."email_id" IS NOT NULL AND "replies"."undone_at" IS NULL

requests_sent.name: requests_sent
requests_sent.value: ("requests"."send_status" = 'SENT') = ("requests"."requested_on" IS NOT NULL AND "requests"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)

users_username_format.name: users_username_format
users_username_format.value: "users"."username" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9._-]*' AND length("users"."username") BETWEEN 2 AND 64

write_offs_decision.name: write_offs_decision
write_offs_decision.value:
("write_offs"."state" = 'PROPOSED' AND "write_offs"."decided_by" IS NULL AND "write_offs"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "write_offs"."ledger_entry_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("write_offs"."state" = 'APPROVED' AND "write_offs"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "write_offs"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "write_offs"."ledger_entry_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("write_offs"."state" = 'REJECTED' AND "write_offs"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "write_offs"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "write_offs"."ledger_entry_id" IS NULL
          AND length(trim("write_offs"."decision_note")) > 0)
